name: bonk
description: Your site is down, bonk! Uptime monitoring and a status page that runs entirely on Cloudflare Workers + D1.

DB.description: D1 database that stores monitors, check history, incidents and settings.

ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Password for `/admin` and private status pages. Used only when Cloudflare Access is **not** configured. Pick something long.

ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: Encrypts notification credentials (bot tokens, webhook URLs) at rest. Any long random string, e.g. the output of `openssl rand -base64 32`. Don't change it later or saved channels stop working.

CF_TEAM_DOMAIN.description: Optional. Your Cloudflare Access team domain, e.g. `https://yourteam.cloudflareaccess.com`. Set it together with `CF_AUD_TOKEN` to sign in to `/admin` and private status pages with Access instead of a password.

CF_AUD_TOKEN.description: Optional. The **Application Audience (AUD) tag** of the Access application protecting `/admin` and any private status pages.
